notes.title: Patch Notes 3.1.3.0
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone! This patch features the much-requested dodge reverts. As this is surely going to affect the meta in many ways, we've only addressed fighters who have a particular attack in their kit that is either too strong, or lacking a bit. Let us know what you think about the new meta!

[list]
[*] Dodges have been reverted back to the pre-V3.0.0.0 state
[*] Zorbie‘s side melee damage lowered from 5 to 4
[*] Meat Boy’s up melee cooldown increased from 8 to 11 frames
[*] Shovel Knight's up melee startup increased from 7 to 10 frames
[*] Stardrop’s side melee startup lowered from 6 to 4 frames
[*] Orcane’s side melee startup lowered from 14 to 12 frames
[*] When in Fraud Detection, using Kick's down special and landing on the ground has the same effect as PartyStarter.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 3.0.8.0 Update
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes V3.0.8.0[/b]
Howdy pardners, this update focus primarily on mini-reworks for Velocispider & Welltaro. Basically, the goal is to reduce the problematic areas of their kits, and buff the parts that are undertuned. Hopefully these changes will yield new and enjoyable options, without nuking the parts of their kits that make them unique.

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new skins in the shop (Can you guess who they are for?)
[*] Fixed a bug that took away teching i-frames when you roll directly after a tech
[*] Tutorial laser now lets you dodge through
[*] Camera adjusted on the head-jumping tutorial room so you can see the next Xenorg
[/list]

[b]Velocispider[/b]
[list]
[*] Down Special now has greatly reduced knockback
[*] Down melee knockback increased
[*] Velocispider can now hold down melee so that the attack fires when the button is released
[*] Heavily reduced SUPER startup
[*] Lowered SUPER damage from 3 to 2 per hit,
[*] Greatly reduced knockback so that it turns into a multi-hit move
[*] Up Special now has a window of startup right before he explodes so there's a window where he can be hit
[*] Side melee now launches enemies up at a higher angle, reducing chaining, but setting up for his upward attacks
[/list]

[b]Welltaro[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased landing squish duration when he’s out of ammo
[*] Changed Heart Balloon damage from 8 & 10 to 6 & 9
[*] Increased active frames and max active frames of puncher bullets
[*] Increased move speed of puncher bullets slightly
[*] Increased initial jump height for puncher
[*] Removed Candle from SUPER upgrade pool
[*] Add a new SUPER upgrade called “Rest in Pieces”
[*] Increased hitbox size on side special’s kick
[*] increased knockback power of side special’s kick
[*] Slightly decreased knockback power of up melee
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - V3.0.5.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone we've got a fancy new update for you all. In case you can't tell, we're continuously trying to even out the tier list by giving small nerfs to fighters dominating the meta, as well as buffing those at the bottom. This update also brings 3 new stage variants! Congrats to the winners of the latest contest. And if yours wasn't chosen, we actually plan to add a couple more Blockworld variants in future updates. There were so many great ones. But we can only make so many at a time!

Bullet-kin
[list]
[*] Magnum damage lowered from 2 to 1
[*] Empowered Magnum damage lowered from 3 to 2
[/list]

Fishy
[list]
[*] Fishlets can no longer be used to kill someone
[/list]

Kick
[list]
[*] Divekick base damage raised from 5 to 6 (Headshot and New Angle still add +1 each on top of base damage)
[/list]

Penelope
[list]
[*] Penelope can now use Engine Boost to absorb her Vampire Mine and deal damage with Engine Boost's hitbox
[/list]

Stardrop
[list]
[*] Lowered Stardrop's up special damage from 8 to 7
[*] Stardrop's Downward Starshot can no longer destroy Penelope's Vampire Mines
[/list]

Teslakid
[list]
[*] Bug fixed that prevented Teslakid from aiming his Grounded Charge properly
[/list]

Yolk
[list]
[*] Yolk's bomb damage has been raised from 3 to 5
[/list]

General
[list]
[*] 4 new Blockworld variants added
[*] Slight visual update for Blockworld backgrounds
[*] 1 new trophy added to the gachapon
[/list]

Patch notes video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_3GdGTqx7cw&feature=emb_logo
